design_scope.purpose: Define a deterministic aggregate-first acceptance method for the current useful-output parity requirement that does not fabricate or depend on an unknown hidden scheduled-Chat runner/template identity. This artifact is a method specification, not live acceptance evidence.

aggregate_first_decision_order.rule: Require exact frozen root/config identities, clean boundary, artifact identity/readback lineage, and no own-state CAS/input conflict. Failure blocks positive use.

Before any per-record positive conclusion, require every in-scope required control to have an unambiguous expected class and result binding. Missing required controls, ambiguous lineage, or unsupported completion for a required canonical case is HARD_REJECT.
Require at least one comparable fail/pass opportunity whenever a useful-output criterion is present. Zero comparable cases is HARD_REJECT, never denominator-neutral PASS.

Evaluate exactly one normalized criterion form with a deterministic comparator. Missing useful-output evidence, criterion ambiguity, comparator ambiguity, below-threshold output, or absence of an explicit structured pass is HARD_REJECT for a claim that compatibility/parity/output-gate satisfaction was achieved.

Design-level classification may remain identity-agnostic, but a current positive live acceptance claim additionally requires independently evidenced exact checker identity and independently evidenced underlying ChatGPT-facing runner identity. When runner identity is unproven, current live positive acceptance remains ineligible.
Only after all prior gates and exact authority revalidation may a current positive acceptance claim be published. This design artifact itself never satisfies that barrier.

normalized_useful_output_contract.path_scope: This is the single canonical path defined by this design artifact only; it is not asserted to be an existing hidden runner/schema path.

semantic_threshold.deterministic_rule: For gte, pass iff observed_value >= threshold; for lte, pass iff observed_value <= threshold. comparator_id and evidence_ref must be nonempty and independently traceable.

structured_pass.deterministic_rule: Pass iff structured_pass is exactly boolean true and evidence_ref is nonempty and independently traceable.

normalized_useful_output_contract.ambiguity_rule: If both variants are populated, neither is populated when a criterion is required, comparator semantics are unspecified, or more than one criterion path competes for authority, classify HARD_REJECT.
normalized_useful_output_contract.empty_evidence_rule: Missing or empty useful post-state/output evidence is HARD_REJECT for a claimed useful-output/parity pass.

paired_fail_pass_contract.pairing_rule: A valid pair must bind the same compatibility/parity/output-gate scope, same required-control set, same evidence protocol, and same normalized useful-output criterion; the pair may differ only in the useful post-state/output evidence and the resulting criterion satisfaction needed to expose the gate boundary.
paired_fail_pass_contract.failing_class: The report/message claims compatibility, parity, or output-gate satisfaction while useful post-state/output evidence is absent or empty, below an explicit semantic threshold, or not an explicit structured pass.
paired_fail_pass_contract.passing_class: The matched case uses the same required controls and evidence protocol and has independently evidenced useful post-state/output meeting the single normalized criterion.
paired_fail_pass_contract.reason: No fresh non-synthetic matched fail/pass dataset is bound to this slice.

unsupported_and_scope_classification.unsupported_nonrequired_fixture: BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED or PARTIAL according to declared scope; never fabricate values.
unsupported_and_scope_classification.lexical_precedence_only: PARTIAL; lexical precedence is not canonical acceptance evidence.
unsupported_and_scope_classification.runner_identity_unproven: PARTIAL for runner-confidence scope and ineligible for current positive live acceptance.

method_claim.claim: The method makes the useful-output boundary deterministic and aggregate-first while remaining sound when hidden runner identity is unknown because it suppresses positive live acceptance until independent runner/checker evidence exists.

continuation: Fresh bootstrap; resolve current evaluation LATEST/checkpoint and exact-read this design artifact. Next highest-value leaf should bind a fresh non-synthetic matched fail/pass useful-output dataset to exactly one normalized criterion/comparator under the same required control family, or, if such evidence is unavailable, materialize the next current checker/control artifact required by the config13 materialize-readback-precommit-execute order. Do not claim positive live acceptance while canonical ChatGPT-facing runner identity remains unproven.
